goal.request: Evaluate whether the frozen target-directed adult interaction visual obligations survive prompt composition and built-in image generation with a facial-appearance reference.

evidence.claim: The frozen v6 candidate pack, composed prompt, and both concrete-reference runtime requests passed repository contract audits without changing the official pack or composed prompt.
The frozen final prompt passed its composed-prompt audit and literally binds the four required interaction evidence phrases.
Attempt 02 visibly passed same-target, invitation-action, and target-consequence gates but failed coordinated orientation because the torso remained substantially camera-frontal.
The single targeted repair visibly rotated the woman's shoulder and torso plane toward the same man while preserving the other three passing gates; all four frozen hard gates pass in attempt 03.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: One visible adult man must receive the woman's gaze, head, torso, and concrete threshold-or-object invitation, and his visible pause-or-reach response must remain readable.

invariants.statement: The gaze, body direction, offered canister, and responding hand must form one unambiguous two-adult causal interaction.
The supplied portrait controls only adult facial appearance and dark wavy hairstyle; identity and user aesthetic approval remain outside the evaluation.

mismatches.source_state: Irises, head, and torso converge on the same visible adult man.
mismatches.render_state: In attempt 02 the irises and head turned toward him, but the broad chest-and-shoulder plane remained substantially frontal to the camera.

hypotheses.statement: The initial generation treated the extended canister arm as sufficient directional evidence and under-expressed the separately required torso rotation.
hypotheses.falsifier: A repeat using the same frozen prompt consistently shows an unmistakably target-turned torso without a targeted repair.

intervention.general_rule: No skill revision is claimed; retain exact-input auditing and direct per-gate pixel review for this bounded evaluation.
intervention.generalization_basis: One motivating render and one repair cannot establish a transferable source-level correction without an independent held-out case.

decision.rationale: The motivating case passes all four visual gates after one bounded torso-orientation repair. No source change, cross-arm holdout, identity claim, or user-aesthetic claim is made.
